title: GGT–ALT joint encoding does not establish incremental albuminuria prediction across independent NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (n=4522/4228), a logGGT-by-logALT spline surface changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 1.105370 to 1.208811, delta +0.103441 (joint PSU-bootstrap95% [-0.048401,+1.205966]). The registered improvement criterion failed; this is an encoding test, not discovery of a new biomarker.
